
# Branch Protection Policy for `main`

1. Require pull request reviews: 1–2 approvals
2. Require status checks to pass (include build/test jobs if configured)
3. Dismiss stale approvals: Enabled
4. Restrict who can push: CODEOWNERS only
5. Block force pushes: Enabled
6. Require signed commits: Enabled (recommended)
7. Enforce linear history: Enabled
